question: Which of the following acts in India was based on report of a committee headed by the British Prime Minister Lord North?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Regulating Act 1773**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Regulating Act was passed in the British Parliament in June 1773.

 
 
• It was the first parliamentary ratification and authorization defining the power and authority of east India company with respect to its Indian possessions.
 
 
 
• Reason / Background for passing the act
 
 
• The East India Company was in severe financial crisis and had asked a loan of 1 million pounds from the British government in 1772.
 
• Allegation of corruption and nepotism were rampant against company officials.
 
• Complexities created due to the dual form of administration instituted by Robert clive.
 
• The defeat of the company against Mysore's Hyder Alii in 1769.
 
 
 
• Provision of the regulating act
 
 
• Permitted the company to retain its territorial possessions in u=India under its control but regulated the activity of a company that's wahy is called regulating act.
 
• Provision for appointment of governor-general assisted with four councilors.
 
• Warren hasting was the first governor-general.
 
• The governor in council at Madras and Bombay were brought under the direct control of Bengal.
 
• Provision for the establishment of the supreme court at forte William Calcutta.
 
 
 
• Drawbacks of the regulating act
 
 
• The governor-general had no veto power.
 
• Power of the supreme court ere not well defined.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Charter Act, 1793:__

 __
 
• ​​__Charter Act of 1793 put municipal institutions on a statutory basis. 
 
• This meant that they were now legally recognized and could function under the authority of the British East India Company. 
 
• The Act also gave the municipalities the power to collect taxes and spend money on local improvements, such as roads, bridges, and schools.
 
• The Charter Act of 1793 was a significant step in the development of municipal government in India. 
 
• It helped to create a more efficient and accountable system of local administration, and it laid the foundation for the modern municipal system that exists in India today.
 
 
 
• Pitt's India Act 1784:
 
 
• It established an authority in England to supervise the company's affairs. This is known as the Board of Control having 6 members.
 
• Governor-General in the council has more powers over Bombay and Madras Governors in matters related to the War, Revenue and Diplomacy.
 
• In India, the strength of the executive council was reduced from four to three.
 
• The term ‘British possessions in India’ was used for the first time.
 
 
 
• **Government of India act 1858**
 
 
• Government of India Act 1858 provided that India will be governed by and in the name of Her Majesty. Designation of Governor-General of India was changed to Viceroy of India and Lord Canning became the first Viceroy of India.
 
• Office of Secretary of State was established which was given complete authority and control over Indian administration. The Secretary of State was a member of the British cabinet and ultimately responsible to British Parliament.
 
• Government of India Act 1858 established a 15 member Council of India to assist the Secretary of State. Secretary of State was made the Chairman of this council.
 
• Government of India Act 1858 also abolished the system of double government.
